question: If the measure of each interior angle of a regular polygon is 140°, then the number of its diagonals will be:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Each exterior angle = 180° − Interior angle = 180° − 140° = 40°

Number of sides (n) = 360° ÷ Exterior angle = 360° ÷ 40° = 9

Number of diagonals = n(n − 3) ÷ 2

⇒ Diagonals = 9 × 6 ÷ 2 = 27

**∴ The correct answer is 27.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Measure of each interior angle of the regular polygon = 140°

**Formula Used:**

Each interior angle = (n − 2) × 180° ÷ n

Number of diagonals = n(n − 3) ÷ 2

Where n = number of sides of the polygon.

**Calculation:**

⇒ (n − 2) × 180 ÷ n = 140

⇒ 180n − 360 = 140n

⇒ 180n − 140n = 360

⇒ 40n = 360

⇒ n = 9

The regular polygon has 9 sides, meaning it is a Nonagon.

⇒ Number of diagonals = 9 × (9 − 3) ÷ 2

⇒ Number of diagonals = 9 × 6 ÷ 2

⇒ Number of diagonals = 54 ÷ 2

⇒ Number of diagonals = 27

**∴ The correct answer is 27.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Sum of Interior Angles

The sum of all interior angles of an n-sided polygon is given by (n − 2) × 180°.

Exterior Angles

The sum of the exterior angles of any convex polygon is always 360°. For a regular polygon, each exterior angle is equal to 360° ÷ n.

Number of Diagonals

The total number of diagonals that can be drawn in any n-sided polygon is calculated using the formula n(n − 3) ÷ 2.
